notes.title: Meet us @ Gamebox Herning [25.4 - 27.4]
notes.content:
Guardian Avatars, Gather around!
Friday the 25th to Sunday the 27th we are live at  Game Box Festival in Herning, Denmark 🎉
Here you’ll be able to do an early playthrough of our Demo, that we are happy to announce will launch on 
May 22nd! 

This demo will take you through the first few levels of the game, and give you a sense of both gameplay and story.

Additionally we’ve decided to release Monolith Dominion in three installment, where each will provide more value through added levels, new mechanics and more story content! 
We'll have more information on this in connection with the demo launch

So, Guardian Avatars, keep a sharp eye on the leylines, and stay tuned for more information on our upcoming release 👀
